page.layout: One printed page: running text in a single column, with headings "AURI, THVRIS, MYRRHÆ" and "CHRISMATIS, OLEI SANCTI" set apart; page number and running head at top; catchword at foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: quemadmodum cum aquâ benedictâ, sale, herbis, & similibus fieri solet: idque absque pretio & expensis laicorum, ut populus simplex ita feducatur, & damno afficiatur, nec non avaritiæ detestandæ præsumtio evitetur.
main_text.head: AURI, THURIS, MYRRHÆ, die Epiphaniæ.
main_text.p: Per hos sacros sermones Evangelii (postquam historicum textus de Magis prælectus fuerit) & per merita sanctorum trium Regum dignare, omnipotens Deus, benedicere has creaturas thuris & myrrhæ, & thymiamatis & auri sive argenti, dextera tua, & præsta, ut omnes in te credentes, & odorem illorum gustantes, ab omni ægritudine absolvantur.

Quæsumus, per filium, in virtute Spiritus sancti, hoc aurum & argetum, quod benedicimus, benedicas, quod in tuo nomine sanctificamus, & consecramus, cœlesti ac perpetuâ sanctificatione sanctifices, ut infidiis diabolicæ fraudis obsistat, sanitatem animæ & corporis, tuâ opitulatione, operans, contraria valetudinis incommoda depellat.
main_text.head: CHRISMATIS, OLEI SANCTI, & olei Catechumenorum, die Cœnæ Dominicæ.

page.notes: Catchword "Christi-" at lower right; the paragraph beginning "Chri-" is cut off at the foot of the page. The page-foot line is read as the catchword. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
